workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison. I've double-checked all the calendars and there are no 30-minute slots where all four partners are free next week. To find a solution, I suggest we identify all the times that work for at least three of the partners. This might give us some options to propose, in case one person can reschedule something. I'll start looking for slots that work for (Elena, David, and Priya) and (Elena, David, and Marcus). Can you please look for slots that work for (Priya, Marcus, and Elena) and (Priya, Marcus, and David)? Let me know what you find.
